# core
> Who Rogier is, how he likes to work, what is live right now

## Rogier
- Rogier Pennink, software engineer in Amsterdam (Europe/Amsterdam). Works alone on his own products; no team.
- Address him as Rogier. Dutch native, prefers English for work chats.
- Detail-oriented; finds abstract talk hard to act on - give concrete examples. Short answers, plain language, no em dashes.
- Pushes back hard on over-engineering; values simplicity, robustness, long-term maintainability over dev cost.

## Standing preferences
- Morning check-ins around 08:30; do not ping between 22:00 and 07:30 unless something is on fire.
- Decisions get an ADR in `docs/adr/`; glossary terms go in `CONTEXT.md`.
- Never paste secrets into chat; refer to where they live.

## Live right now
- Building Hydra (agent orchestration platform, successor to old agentick) - see topic `hydra-project`.
- Discord is the main channel to reach Rogier; Slack is secondary.

## Server "Rogier's lab"
- Guild id 1098823001177342
- Channels: #general (chat), #ops (bot alerts and CI noise), #hydra-dev (build discussion), DM with Rogier for everything private.
- #ops channel id: 1188429077315

## Bot
- Bot user "Athena"; application created 2026-07; runs on the Mac mini under launchd.
- Token stored in the 1Password vault "hydra-ops" (never paste it).
- Intents enabled: message content, guild messages, direct messages.
- Mention-gated in channels, always-on in DMs.
memory.topics/hydra-project:
# hydra-project
> Hydra architecture decisions, repo facts, open threads

## Facts
- Repo: github.com/rogierpennink/hydra (local dir agentick-next). TypeScript, clean slate.
- Controller/runner split: runner dials the controller; controller owns domain state, runner owns material state.
- One SQLite database on the controller is the source of truth. No repo-local config, ever.
- Providers wrap Claude Code (Agent SDK), Codex app-server and pi. All three installed on the Mac mini.
- Channels v1: Discord + Slack. Event sources v1: GitHub, Gmail, cron, manual.

## Decisions (ADRs merged so far)
- 0001 runs freeze an execution plan
- 0002 orchestration stays on the controller
- 0003 sessions run as bare processes
- 0004 controller state lives in one SQLite database
- 0014 assistants remember through distilled memory, not merged sessions

## Open threads
- Packaging: single binary vs npm install still undecided; Bun compile under evaluation.
- Runner join ceremony: token format not settled.
- Memory interface prototype (this assistant is the guinea pig).

# rogier
> Background, people around Rogier, recurring personal logistics

## Background
- Ran a Python agent orchestrator called agentick for ~2 years; abandoned because repo-local config made every repo a special case. Hydra is the do-over.
- Comfortable in TypeScript, Python, Go. Dislikes YAML-heavy tooling.
- Uses a Mac mini as his always-on box at home; MacBook Pro for daily work.

## People
- Sanne: partner. Weekends are hers; don't schedule Saturday work.
- Marco: former colleague, occasional sounding board for architecture questions.

## Logistics
- Dentist: practice on Ceintuurbaan, next appointment 2026-10-03 09:00.
- Car inspection (APK) due November.
- Gym Tue/Thu evenings.

# hydra-project
> Hydra architecture decisions, repo facts, open threads

## Facts
- Repo: github.com/rogierpennink/hydra (local dir agentick-next). TypeScript, clean slate.
- Controller/runner split: runner dials the controller; controller owns domain state, runner owns material state.
- One SQLite database on the controller is the source of truth. No repo-local config, ever.
- Providers wrap Claude Code (Agent SDK), Codex app-server and pi. All three installed on the Mac mini.
- Channels v1: Discord + Slack. Event sources v1: GitHub, Gmail, cron, manual.

## Decisions (ADRs merged so far)
- 0001 runs freeze an execution plan
- 0002 orchestration stays on the controller
- 0003 sessions run as bare processes
- 0004 controller state lives in one SQLite database
- 0014 assistants remember through distilled memory, not merged sessions

## Open threads
- Packaging: single binary vs npm install still undecided; Bun compile under evaluation.
- Runner join ceremony: token format not settled.
- Proposed teardown ownership: controller owns the logical deadline; runner enforces it locally, performs workspace/process cleanup, and reports the result.
- Memory interface prototype (this assistant is the guinea pig).
